The licence names no Reserved Font Name.

Modified versions, made for tlm-kalendar by scripts/fonts/make-fonts.py:
- ebg-latin-*.woff2, ebg-latin-ext-*.woff2: the Latin and Latin Extended subsets as distributed by the npm package
  @fontsource/eb-garamond, with the OpenType language system for Latin (LAT) removed. In the original files that language
  system replaces u, U and v by the forms u.LAT, U.LAT and v.LAT (u drawn as v) in text marked lang="la".
- ebg-vr.ttf: the two signs U+211F (℟) and U+2123 (℣) cut out of EBGaramond[wght].ttf from the Google Fonts repository.
These modified files are distributed under the same licence.
